definitions.short: crimson , properly, the insect or its color, also stuff dyed with it
definitions.full: H8144. shani שָׁנִי 42 noun [masculine] scarlet (properly coccus ilicis , which attaches itself to leaves and twigs of quercus coccifera ; the dried body of female yields colouring matter; compare Tristr NHB 319 Post Hast. DB SCARLET M'Lean Ency. Bib. id .); — usually הַשּׁ ׳חוּט הַזֶּה שָׁ ׳תִּקְוַת Josh 2:18 this cord of thread of scarlet , ׳ת ׳הַשּׁ 2:21 , הַשּׁ ׳חוּט Song 4:3 (simile of lips); so ׳(הַ)שּׁ alone Gen 38:28 , 30 (J), and as material of clothing 2Sam 1:24 ; Jer 4:30 ; Prov 31:21 (plural שָׁנִים ; on order of ll. see Toy); plural also in simile Isa 1:18 if your sins are like scarlet (robes); elsewhere (P) (הַ)שּׁ ׳תּוֺלַעַת (see ׳ת ) of material for curtain, veil, ephod, etc., Exod 25:4 ; 26:1 24 t. Exodus; ת ׳בֶּגֶד ׳שׁ Num 4:3 (see II. ׳ב 2 ); construct (הַ)תּ ׳שְׁנִי used in purification, Lev 14:4 , 6 , 49 , 51 , 52 ; Num 19:6 .
